# SK Attestations

> Independent document attestation and legalization assistance from Pakistan. Attestation, verification and acceptance decisions are made by the competent authorities, not by this site.

## Key pages

- [Check My Documents](https://ksa.salaroutsourcing.com/check-documents/): Guided check that identifies the stages a document may need. No files required.
- [Document assistance services](https://ksa.salaroutsourcing.com/services/): Assistance for educational, official-authority and international document processes.
- [Mosadaqa degree attestation in Pakistan](https://ksa.salaroutsourcing.com/guides/mosadaqa-degree-attestation/): What mosadaqa means for a degree used in Saudi Arabia, and how a name difference between the degree, passport and CNIC is resolved.
- [Degree name different from passport?](https://ksa.salaroutsourcing.com/guides/degree-name-different-from-passport/): Which issuer corrects a name difference on a degree, passport or identity record.

## Guides

- [Degree name different from passport?](https://ksa.salaroutsourcing.com/guides/degree-name-different-from-passport/): A degree, passport or CNIC that shows a different spelling or a missing surname needs the right issuer, not another stamp. Compare the records first.
- [MOFA attestation: where to begin](https://ksa.salaroutsourcing.com/guides/mofa-attestation-pakistan/): Start with the document category and the authority that comes before the foreign affairs stage, then confirm the current instructions for your document.
- [Mosadaqa degree attestation in Pakistan](https://ksa.salaroutsourcing.com/guides/mosadaqa-degree-attestation/): Mosadaqa means attestation or verification of a document for Saudi use. See which records must match and how name differences are resolved.
- [Apostille or embassy legalization?](https://ksa.salaroutsourcing.com/guides/apostille-vs-embassy-attestation/): The applicable route depends on treaty status, the document and the recipient, not the destination name alone. Check the right question first.
- [HEC or IBCC: which authority applies?](https://ksa.salaroutsourcing.com/guides/hec-vs-ibcc/): Look at the qualification level and awarding body rather than the word “certificate” when you decide which educational authority to approach.
- [Why was your document rejected?](https://ksa.salaroutsourcing.com/guides/why-documents-get-rejected/): A query or rejection notice tells you which part of the file needs attention. Read the stated reason before you resubmit or pay again.
